summary: Frontend-only regression test for two bug fixes (suggestion-click & new-chat send race) plus follow-up flows. All 10 scripted steps passed. Suggestion cards now dispatch the question → optimistic user msg → loading → assistant report with PDF artifact. Empty-state send button and Enter submission work; Shift+Enter inserts newline; disabling both source chips disables send; enabling one re-enables it. Follow-up on same chat appends messages without losing prior ones (4 messages, 2 PDF artifacts). Sidebar auto-renames chat to first ~60 chars of the question. 'New analysis' button creates a fresh empty state and sending from it transitions correctly without wiping optimistic user message.

issues: Recharts repeatedly logs 'width(-1) and height(-1) ... should be greater than 0' warnings on initial render — ResponsiveContainer parent lacks fixed/min height before layout. Charts still render after reflow but console is noisy. Consider wrapping with a container that has an explicit min-height or using aspect prop.

action_items: (Minor) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height=-1 warnings by giving chart wrapper an explicit minHeight (e.g., 240px) or aspect ratio.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat.jsx handles optimistic update + race cleanly via skipLoadRef — looks good.
Composer disables send correctly when sources.length === 0 or text empty.
No data-testid gaps found for the tested flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both targeted bug fixes verified end-to-end. LLM responses took ~15-30s each. Only outstanding item is cosmetic Recharts width warnings on chart first paint.
